mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in real GDP by more than 1% over the last quarter signals a weakening demand environment, which is likely to lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined by more than 1% in the previous quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 2% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the last month, it indicates a strong demand environment, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by the specified amounts in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the last month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, which is likely to lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decrease > 100k and UNRATE increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where both PAYEMS and UNRATE changed by the specified amounts in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the last quarter, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strong demand environment and an improving labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 2% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both RSAFS and UNRATE changed by the specified amounts in the previous quarter.
